# DEMO130: One Rubric Fixture

**Input:** handwritten

**Sheet:** generic

**Preamble:** Every part here is marked by a person and, separately, by a model.

## Problem 1: Waves

A wave travels in a lossless medium.

```svg
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 40" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><title>Travelling wave</title><desc>A sinusoid moving to the right along z.</desc><path d="M0 20 Q25 0 50 20 T100 20" stroke="#000" fill="none"/></svg>
```

### (a) Expressions [1 pts] [handwritten:human]
Write expressions for (i) frequency in terms of period, (ii) wavelength in terms of $u_p$ and $f$.

> grader_note: SOLUTION. (i) $f = 1/T$. (ii) $\lambda = u_p / f$. Award the point for both.

### (b) Units [0.5 pts] [handwritten:human]
Give the SI unit of each quantity in part (a), with the figure below as reference.

![A labelled wave, period T and wavelength lambda marked](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAAAAAA6fptVAAAACklEQVR4nGNgAAAAAgABc3UBGAAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==)

> grader_note: SOLUTION. Hertz, metres. Half credit for one.

### (c) Nothing written [0.5 pts] [handwritten:human]
Explain in one sentence why a wave carries energy.

## Problem 2: Reflections

### (a) Gamma [1 pts] [handwritten]
Calculate $\Gamma$ for $R_L = 150\,\Omega$ on a $50\,\Omega$ line.

> grading_prompt: Required elements: (1) $\Gamma = (R_L - Z_0)/(R_L + Z_0)$; (2) the value 0.5.
> Award full marks for both. Award no credit for neither.

> grader_note: REFERENCE. $\Gamma = 100/200 = 0.5$.
